title: Brenda Fricker, Oscar winner known for roles in "My Left Foot" and "Home Alone 2," dies at age 81
facts: Irish actor Brenda Fricker died on Thursday night in Dublin at the age of 81.
Phil Belfield served as the talent agent representing Brenda Fricker.
Brenda Fricker won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for her performance in the 1989 film "My Left Foot".
Brenda Fricker was the first Irish woman to win an Academy Award.
Brenda Fricker played the mother of Christy Brown in "My Left Foot" alongside actor Daniel Day-Lewis.
Daniel Day-Lewis won the Academy Award for Best Actor for his role in "My Left Foot".
Brenda Fricker was an original cast member of the BBC medical drama television series "Casualty" when it premiered in 1986.
Brenda Fricker portrayed the character known as the Pigeon Lady in the 1992 film "Home Alone 2: Lost in New York".
Brenda Fricker appeared alongside actor Mike Myers in the 1993 film "So I Married an Axe Murderer".
Brenda Fricker appeared in the 1994 film "Angels in the Outfield" alongside Danny Glover.
Brenda Fricker acted alongside Matthew McConaughey in the 1996 movie "A Time to Kill".
Brenda Fricker performed alongside Cate Blanchett in the 2003 film "Veronica Guerin".
Brenda Fricker's final film appearance was in the 2024 movie "The Swallow".
Brenda Fricker published an autobiography titled "She Died Young: A Life in Fragments" in 2025.
Ireland's Deputy Prime Minister Simon Harris issued a public statement mourning Brenda Fricker's death.
